statement: The proposed local context subgraph enrichment adds triples from the same source passage to each target triple, while SG-RAG MOT retrieves a subgraph from the knowledge graph and applies merging/ordering, and RAG retrieves passages to augment generation; all aim to enrich context but differ in source (passage-derived triples vs KG subgraph vs retrieved passages) and mechanism (direct addition vs merging/ordering vs passage concatenation).
